name: Ring of Incredible Deeds
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Price 36,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring grants the wearer a +2 competence bonus on all physical (Strength, Dexterity or Constitution-based) skill checks and saving throws (Fortitude and Reflex.)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells bull’s strength, bear’s endurance, cat’s grace; Cost 18,000 gp

Identification DC 18
